description: This Java class defines a RecyclerView ViewHolder for displaying share items in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages binding share data to UI components, including setting icons, names, and permissions, and handles different share types such as group, room, circle, federated, and user.

classes.name: ShareViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder for displaying shared items with icons, names, and permissions, supporting different share types and user interactions.

methods.name: ShareViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with binding, account, and context.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds an OCShare object and listener to the view, setting icon, name, and permissions based on share type and user account.

methods.name: setPermissionName
methods.description: Sets the permission name text and visibility based on the provided permission string.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Loads an avatar image into an ImageView, with fallback to a default resource if loading fails.
